item.tib: gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gyi phyag bzhes skal ldan snang ba'i dga' ston
item.coloph: phul byung yon tan rta ljang nor bu'i gzugs/ gang de'i yon tan 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i zer/ skal ldan blo yi yon tan pad dkar 'byed/ 'dzam gling yon tan rgyan gcig 'dza' tshon snying / thugs kyi blo gros rgya mtsho cher thon pa'i/ legs zab rgya che bcom ldan gdugs dkar po/ mkhas grub dam pa'i cod pan rgyan du 'khrungs/ spyod cing snang ba'i dga' ston gyur ba'i gshis/ rag gan gser du brdzu ba'i zob zob pos/ dam pa'i yon tan lhar bsgyar 'os min yang / gyer bstan rtsa lag bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ yang yang bskul phyir bka' la bzlog med ngoraM/ sngon 'byung zab mo'i gsungs la gtsor brten pa'i/ slob ma'i gsungs ltar brda' la legs bkrol nas/ phyag bzhes snang ba'i dga' ston 'di ko kyang / rten grags ming gis blo chung mar gad rtser/ snang rig dung mkhan kha'i glu chung dbyangs ces pa/ 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i rgyan cig skyabs mchog kun grags de nyid kyis/ mkhyen dgongs rgya mtsho chen po'i chu gter las/ thon pa'i yang zab khros ma chen mo gdugs dkar mo'i gzhung las/ bzhed lugs tshom bral phyag bzhes mi 'dug rung / theg dman blo chung gis spyod yul shin tu mi 'os kyang / mched grogs bla ma'i bka' la bzlog tu mi rung zhing / lhag par rang 'dra'i blo chung rnams la phan thog yang cha mi gtong ba'i/ drin chen dam pa'i gsung ltar gzhir grub pa'i/ b+ha d+ha hor gyi tha gru dkor nag kha 'byams skabs su brtsams/ 'gal 'khrul song tshe skyabs yul gnyan la bshags//
